players.product: The Generate Platform (machine-learning generative biology; computational design integrated with large-scale biological experimentation) and AI-engineered protein therapeutics such as GB-0895

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (IPO prospectus): collaboration revenue was $31,893 thousand in 2025 vs $20,459 thousand in 2024; R&D expenses were $224,698 thousand vs $175,311 thousand, including external R&D costs for GB-0895 of $43,530 thousand vs $17,443 thousand and external discovery-related and other costs of $83,392 thousand vs $68,459 thousand; net loss was $222,965 thousand vs $181,384 thousand, and net cash used in operating activities was $200,619 thousand vs $117,750 thousand. Generate reports one operating segment, generative biology using machine learning for drug discovery and development through the programming of novel protein therapeutics; its revenue comes from multiple collaboration agreements under which it licenses development or product candidates and performs research and development services.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 collaboration revenue $31,893 thousand (2024: $20,459 thousand); R&D $224,698 thousand; net loss $222,965 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Manufacturing model and GB-0895 supply scale: Generate does not own or operate, and has no plans to establish, manufacturing facilities; all preclinical and clinical drug supply development, manufacturing, storage, distribution and testing are outsourced to CDMOs and other third parties. GB-0895 drug substance is produced by its CDMO on an established monoclonal antibody platform process scaled to 1,000-liter single-use bioreactors for Phase 1 and Phase 3 supply, with a planned scale-up to 2,000 liters at a commercial-ready facility to support anticipated launch volumes; a high-concentration liquid formulation is being developed to deliver the full 300 mg dose in a single subcutaneous injection. Generate does not have long-term supply contracts with all of its suppliers (its CRO / CDMO contracts carry no minimum purchase commitments and are cancellable on written notice), expects to enter longer-term commercial supply agreements with key suppliers and manufacturers as programs advance, and believes it has access to sufficient manufacturing capacity for its planned clinical development pipeline.
quarterly_data.figure: 1,000-liter single-use bioreactors for Phase 1 and Phase 3 supply; planned scale-up to 2,000 liters; 300 mg single subcutaneous dose

quarterly_data.signal: Lonza (supplier): Generate is party to agreements with Lonza AG, currently its sole provider of drug product for GB-0895. Under a license agreement effective July 1, 2023 with Lonza Sales (a worldwide non-exclusive license under Lonza's gene expression system, patent rights and know-how to manufacture and commercialize certain products), which Generate uses in connection with GB-0895, it agreed to pay up to 1,000,000 Swiss Francs and a low single-digit royalty on net sales if Lonza Sales manufactures the product, or an annual payment in Swiss Francs in the mid-six-digits per sublicense plus a low single-digit royalty if a third party manufactures it.
quarterly_data.figure: sole drug product provider for GB-0895; up to 1,000,000 Swiss Francs plus low single-digit royalty

quarterly_data.signal: WuXi Biologics (supplier): Generate is party to agreements with WuXi Biologics (Cayman) Inc., currently its sole provider of drug product for GB-4362. The prospectus notes that the U.S. BIOSECURE Act, enacted in December 2025 with a five-year grandfathering period for existing contracts, and similar laws or policies could affect contractual counterparties including WuXi and Lonza; Generate says that if such suppliers stopped supplying it, or it were restricted from using them, it could experience delays in its studies and trials while it identifies and qualifies replacement suppliers.
quarterly_data.figure: sole drug product provider for GB-4362

quarterly_data.signal: Roswell Park Comprehensive Cancer Center (manufacturer): given the specialized expertise required to manufacture CAR-T therapies, Generate intends to rely on Roswell Park to manufacture GB-5267.

Amgen (collaboration partner): on July 21, 2025 Generate and Amgen executed an amendment to the Amgen Collaboration Agreement that effectively eliminated the remaining service obligation related to a collaboration target; the remaining fixed transaction price of $4.3 million was re-allocated to the remaining performance obligations, and Generate recorded a cumulative revenue adjustment of approximately $1.3 million.
quarterly_data.figure: $4.3 million remaining transaction price re-allocated; approximately $1.3 million cumulative revenue adjustment
